mentions.text:
The AI infrastructure buildout has three distinct networking layers. Each one is at a different point in its adoption curve and each one has different winners.

1. Scale-up connects GPUs inside a single server and eventually across racks. The transition from copper is happening in stages.

> Copper still dominates at short distances.

> Active electrical cable extends that reach but loses signal integrity as clusters grow.

> LPO removes the DSP entirely, cutting power consumption to near CPO levels while keeping the pluggable form factor operators already know.

> NPO moves optics closer to the chip without full co-packaging. Both are ramping faster than CPO in the near term because they require less ecosystem disruption.

> CPO is the endgame. It integrates optics directly onto the switch ASIC substrate, cutting signal loss from 20dB to 1-2dB and power consumption by 3x or more.

$AVGO's Davisson and $NVDA's Spectrum-X are the CPO platforms. $MRVL acquired Celestial AI to position optics directly on top of XPUs rather than at the die edge, with Amazon as the lead design win. $COHR and $LITE supply the CW and EML lasers every platform requires. $LITE holds more than 50% share in high-speed EML lasers with multi-billion dollar supply agreements locked with Nvidia through end of decade. $CRDO and $MTSI supply the LRO and LPO chipsets capturing near term volume before CPO fully ramps.

2. Scale-out connects servers inside a single data center. The 800G transceiver cycle is at peak volume with 1.6T at the beginning of its inflection.

> $MRVL's 51.2T switches and DSPs sit at the center.

> $AAOI is expanding capacity 10x and demand still outpaces supply through mid-2027.

> $COHR supplies modules across the stack.

3. Scale-across connects data centers to each other over distance so one AI model trains across geographically distributed GPU clusters as a single logical environment. The link between sites requires lossless coherent optical transport at 800G and 1.6T.

> $CIEN holds the number one global position in data center interconnect. Their Q2 executive summary states it directly: "DCI, including scale-across, is gaining momentum as customers connect AI data centers to monetize their investments."

> $COHR and $LITE supply the optical circuit switches enabling spine replacement and redundancy across those links.

**大市**
隔晚一批重磅财报出炉，科技股全线沽压沉重，美股三大指数走势严重分化。纳指 $QQQ 高开后反复急泻，收报704.47点，跌2.86%，为四大指数中表现最差；标普 SPY 收报763.96点，跌1.18%；惟道指 DIA 则逆市靠稳，收报527.86点，微升0.03%，罗素小型股 IWM 收报276.72点，升0.09%，旧经济及中小型股一枝独秀。市宽极度偏弱，106只观察股中仅31只上升，75只下跌，跌股数目为上升股份两倍以上。对冲工具全日造好，三倍沽空半导体的 SOXS 暴升20.68%，SQQQ 升8.55%，SPXU 升3.57%，反映资金积极买入保险。

**板块**
半导体设备及光通讯为全日沽压最集中所在。半导体设备龙头 LRCX 于前一交易日盘后公布业绩，全日重挫11.76%，直接拖累上游资本开支链条；测试设备股 AEHR 急泻12.88%，模拟芯片股 SMTC 挫11.66%。AI网络及光模块一众个股同步崩跌，光器件股 COHR 泻12.51%，LITE 跌11.54%，AAOI 跌11.96%，CIEN 跌10.71%，高速互连股 CRDO 跌10.70%；电讯设备股 NOK 更插水14.81%。医药方面，生物科技股 MRNA 独自泻17.57%，为全日跌幅之最。防守及内需类则逆市造好，家居建材股 HD 升4.33%、LOW 升3.97%，零售股 TGT 升3.76%；军工股 LMT 升6.96%，为全日表现最强个股。软件股亦见资金回流，ADBE 升6.07%，CRM 升3.52%，NFLX 升3.09%。

**焦点**
隔晚财报是全日盘面的主导力量。IBM、LRCX、META、TSLA、TXN 五家公司已于前一交易日盘后公布业绩，相关反应已全数反映在今日盘中，其中 LRCX 的业绩成为半导体设备及AI基建链条当日被集体减持的直接理由。宏观方面，市场焦点仍在波斯湾：据报当地原油出货量已大致回复至冲突爆发前水平，船期与到货恢复正常，惟油价并未同步回落，显示市场定价的并非眼前的实际供应缺口，而是中期选举之后美伊关系再度转向的尾部风险，军工股的强势亦与此一脉相承。值得注意的是，当日避险资产并未呈现一致方向，黄金与加密货币同步走弱，与波动率指数上扬并不协调，显示仓位调整多于真正的避险需求。盘后 BE 及 WDC 公布业绩，其影响将于下一个交易日反映。

**小结**
全日格局属板块内部的剧烈轮动，而非全面抛售——道指与小型股双双收平，沽压高度集中于半导体、光通讯与AI基建链，资金则转入内需、软件与军工。分析指，QQQ 收报704.47点，700点整数关为短线关键支持，一旦失守，科技股的调整或由个别财报失望扩散至整条AI资本开支链；标普 SPY 须重上770水平，方可确认今日跌势仅属单日板块冲击。市宽连日偏弱之下，宜以观察指数能否守住关键位为先，而非急于在跌幅榜中捞底。
